pitch_checkpoint.verdict: Pitch was the defective artifact, not the draft. Three divergences, all downstream of Houfu's deliberate direction in sessions 5-9: (1) voice.lane still said learning-in-public after he ruled the post a tutorial — would have made audit-tone flag the tutorial register as a defect and wasted the single audit round; (2) beats listed 8 sections under stale titles, draft has 9; (3) thesis used 'clauses', now excised vocabulary. Pitch amended to match on all three. Subject and scope unchanged — still building against MCPs with Zeeker as the worked source, no drift from the Original framing. Flagged to Houfu rather than fixed: the declared emotional core has moved from the opening to one line at the close.
